title: ProteinMPNN Input Parameters
description: Normalized request shape for the ProteinMPNN sequence-design adapter. ProteinMPNN consumes backbones (not targets) and emits FASTA sequences.

backbones.description: List of backbone structures to design sequences for. Typically S3 URIs resolved into /inputs/backbones/*.pdb at runtime.

seeds.description: Random seeds for sampling; one run per seed, producing num_seq_per_target sequences each.

omit_aas.description: Single-letter amino acids to exclude from designed sequences. 'X' is always recommended; 'C' removes cysteines.

num_seq_per_target.description: Number of sequences to sample per backbone per seed.

fixed_positions.description: Optional per-chain fixed residue indices (1-based). Keys are chain IDs; values are lists of residue indices whose identity should NOT be redesigned.
